title: Map, occupancy, parser and adjudicator boundary
summary: 75 provinces, 34 centres, 81 graph nodes, 504 directed army/fleet adjacency edges. Initial deployment file has 22 units. Order parser preserves original text and applies static validity only.
invariants: Occupancy key is board~provinceOf(location); fleet adjacency uses actual coast nodes.
F CON - BUL is ambiguous; F CON - BUL/SC is valid; F RUM - BUL/SC invalid. Support can target BUL without coast.
Last recognizable owned-unit order wins, earlier records SUPERSEDED; no premature legality feedback.
Convoy routes, matching supports, strength, dislodgement, retreat collisions, adjustment counts and civil disorder are NOT solved by the parser.
Sorted directory traversal whenever results or logs depend on iteration.

provenance.claim: Referee-side parser and static validation only.
Independent standard map adjacency and home ownership reference.
